record.paper_title: Open questions for operators related to rectangular Catalan combinatorics
record.original_question: For any good seed g_d, meaning a seed whose associated functions g_d^(a,b)(x;q,t) are Schur-positive, and for every coprime pair of positive integers b >= a, prove the transpose Schur inclusion bar(g_d^(b,a)(x;q,t)) <=_s g_d^(a,b)(x;q,t). The bar operator is needed because g_d^(b,a) and g_d^(a,b) have different symmetric-function degrees.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Lambda = \Lambda(x;q,t)$ denote the ring of symmetric functions in the variables $x = (x_1, x_2, \ldots)$ over $\mathbb{Q}(q,t)$. For each coprime pair of positive integers $(a,b)$, let $g_d^{(a,b)}(x;q,t) \in \Lambda$ be the symmetric function obtained by applying a fixed family of operators indexed by $d$ to the constant $1$ in the rectangular Catalan combinatorics setup, so that $g_d^{(a,b)}$ is bihomogeneous in $(q,t)$ and homogeneous of a definite degree as a symmetric function in $x$.

Call a seed $g_d$ "good" if $g_d^{(a,b)}(x;q,t)$ is Schur-positive for every coprime pair of positive integers $(a,b)$, i.e. its expansion in the Schur basis $\{s_\lambda\}$ has coefficients in $\mathbb{N}[q,t]$.

For symmetric functions $f, h \in \Lambda$ with Schur expansions $f = \sum_\lambda f_\lambda s_\lambda$ and $h = \sum_\lambda h_\lambda s_\lambda$ (coefficients in $\mathbb{N}[q,t]$), write $f \leq_s h$ to mean $h - f$ is Schur-positive, i.e. $h_\lambda - f_\lambda \in \mathbb{N}[q,t]$ for every partition $\lambda$.

For a symmetric function $f$ that is homogeneous of degree $n$, let $\overline{f}$ denote the "degree-shifted" companion obtained by multiplication with the appropriate Schur function so that $\overline{f}$ has the same symmetric-function degree as $g_d^{(a,b)}$ when applied to $f = g_d^{(b,a)}$ (this is the bar operator employed to compensate for the differing degrees of $g_d^{(a,b)}$ and $g_d^{(b,a)}$).

Prove: for every good seed $g_d$ and every coprime pair of positive integers with $b \geq a \geq 1$,
$$\overline{g_d^{(b,a)}(x;q,t)} \;\leq_s\; g_d^{(a,b)}(x;q,t).$$
artifact.category_tag: Rectangular Catalan / Schur positivity of symmetric function operators
artifact.status_search_result: The question was posed as an open problem on operators in rectangular Catalan combinatorics. While more recent work (e.g., on Demazure crystals and Catalan functions, and on k-Schur positivity) has resolved certain Schur-positivity conjectures in this circle of ideas, no source located confirms a proof of the specific transpose Schur-inclusion between $\overline{g_d^{(b,a)}}$ and $g_d^{(a,b)}$ for all good seeds. Status appears unresolved based on available evidence.

status_evidence.title: Open Questions for operators related to Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics
status_evidence.snippet: Formulates open questions on Schur positivity of operators in rectangular Catalan combinatorics, including transpose-type Schur inclusions.
status_evidence.claim: The question is recorded as an open problem in this collection of conjectures.

status_evidence.title: Demazure crystals and the Schur positivity of Catalan functions
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes Schur positivity for Catalan functions via Demazure crystals, settling some related conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: Related Schur-positivity questions in this area have seen progress, but the specific transpose inclusion is not addressed here.
